decision: Use existing native L1MemoryManager behind one operation owner
why: L1Manager owns allocation and uses TTL expiry for reclamation

decision: Cast native byte views to unsigned bytes
why: The native ctypes view exposes unsupported assignment format <B
result: first probe allocated 4096 physical bytes for 37 logical bytes; write failed before cast

decision: Use one uniquely named POSIX SHM mapping
why: The ordinary torch fallback adds a page beyond its reported usable pool; SHM mapping size is inspectable
result: Exact mapping size and unlink passed in the runner

decision: Keep real byte and failure checks in the standalone experiment
why: Operation pins must survive paused copying and failed allocation without granting capacity

decision: Leave MP integration and peer transfer unimplemented
why: A local common-pool experiment cannot establish network visibility or transport completion
result: Explicit limitation in manual guide and results

decision: Self-review implementation and hand the isolated branch to the coordinator
why: Task instructions prohibit extra subagents; no independent reviewer result is claimed
result: Local review and static checks passed
